# CBC.ca

> Canada's public broadcaster offering comprehensive news, sports, radio, television, and streaming content across all platforms.

CBC.ca serves as the digital hub for the Canadian Broadcasting Corporation, providing breaking news, live sports coverage, radio programming, and on-demand entertainment through multiple integrated platforms including CBC Gem streaming service. The site aggregates content across national and international news, entertainment, business, and sports with emphasis on Canadian perspectives and coverage.

## Key Topics

- Canadian News
- Breaking News
- CBC Sports
- CBC Radio
- CBC Television
- CBC Gem Streaming
- Entertainment
- World News
- Business News
- Current Events
- Public Media
- Live Coverage
- Multimedia Content
- Politics Canada
- Canadian Broadcaster

## News & Current Events

- [CBC.ca - watch, listen, and discover with Canada's Public Broadcaster](https://www.cbc.ca): CBC homepage offering news, entertainment, sports, music and multimedia content
- [CBC News - Latest Canada, World, Entertainment and Business News](https://www.cbc.ca/news): CBC News aggregator covering Canadian, world, entertainment and business news
- [Global markets sink, fuel prices soar as Iran hits Gulf refineries in multiple countries | CBC](https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/livestory/us-israel-iran-war-9.7134369): Live news coverage of Iran's attacks on Gulf refineries and global market impact
- [2 teens arrested over alleged plan to stage joint school attacks | CBC.ca](https://www.cbc.ca/player/play/video/9.7134293): News video on arrests of two teens in Manitoba and Nova Scotia for alleged coordinated school attack plot

## Sports

- [CBC Sports - sports news, opinion, video and streaming](https://www.cbc.ca/sports): CBC Sports hub with news, opinions and live streaming of hockey, basketball and more

## Radio & Audio

- [CBC Radio](https://www.cbc.ca/radio): CBC Radio One destination for Canadian news, current affairs and cultural programming

## Television & Streaming

- [CBC Television](https://www.cbc.ca/television): CBC Television streaming hub for shows, sports coverage and Canadian entertainment content
- [CBC Gem](https://gem.cbc.ca): CBC Gem streaming platform for TV shows, films and live TV across all devices
